summary: Polestar Automotive Holding UK PLC filed a Form 6-K containing its MD&A, unaudited interim financial statements, and a press release for the six months ended June 30, 2026. This is a routine periodic disclosure of financial results by a foreign private issuer under the 1934 Act. No special-situation event — such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or strategic review — is announced. The filing is solely an earnings and operational update with forward-looking statements. What to watch: future reporting for any corporate actions, but this filing represents routine current reporting only.
